_about: Bought parts with a published mass (vt350#60). The model's solids for a bought part are a mockup: their volume isn't the real part's, and most carry FreeCAD's weightless Default material. Each part here gets one card with an EFFECTIVE density, so that its Default solids plus its solids that already have a material add up to the published mass: density = (mass_g - known_g) / default_mm3. default_mm3 and known_g are measured on measured_on (cad/passes lite-63 re-measures them and refuses to save if they've changed). Only published figures go here: the part's own, or, when its maker publishes none, a same-size, same-type part's from another maker (owner, 2026-11-17: "they would not vary by much"), said so in its source; parts without one stay Default until the owner weighs them (vt350#60 AC6). materials: real materials bought as parts (magnets), with their datasheet density; one plain card each.

parts.name: Bought LDO Orbiter v2.5 with motor
parts.source: Orbiter Projects (the designer), Orbiter v2.0 page, read 2026-11-17: "Weight reduced to ~135 grams". The Orbiter v2.5 page says v2.5 uses the v2.0 body and gives no weight of its own. Neither page says which motor the figure is with: the owner's is the LDO 36STH20 (notes/parts-owned.md), the model's mockup has the 36STH17. The ~140 g figure some resellers quote is the older Orbiter v1.x's, 'with the 17mm stepper'.
parts.selector: every solid under the group 'Orbiter V2.0 Mockup' in each head, except the bowden tubes (Bowden Left, Bowden Right) and stand-ins

parts.name: Bought Beacon RevH Normal
parts.source: beacon3d.com home page, read 2026-11-17: "Attach the 3.5g Beacon to your printer toolhead" (no revision named; the cable not counted).
parts.selector: the solid 'Beacon RevH Normal (Beacon CAD, MIT)' on the carriage

parts.name: Bought Vindr Berserker 4010B blower
parts.source: Berserker (and West3D, BER1429) publish no weight; read 2026-11-17. A same-size, same-type stand-in figure (owner's choice): 24 V 40x40x10 dual-ball blowers weigh 15 g: KB3D's 4010 blower (9,500 rpm, with a 15 cm lead), Senhar's 4010A datasheet (15.0 g), GDSTime GDB4010 (12 g at 9,500 rpm, 15 g at 12,000 rpm). The Berserker is a high-speed blower, so 15 g. Replace with the owner's scale (vt350#60 AC6).
parts.selector: the blower solid 'Blower_4010' (each head's two 'Vindr Berserker 4010B blower' are links to it)

parts.name: Bought 2510 hotend fan
parts.source: The owner's 2510 fan's maker isn't recorded; a same-size, same-type stand-in figure (owner's choice): Sunon MF25101V1-1000U-A99 (25x25x10 axial, 12 V; the 24 V version's mechanics are the same) datasheet, read 2026-11-17: "WEIGHT 6.8 g". Replace with the owner's scale (vt350#60 AC6).
parts.selector: the solid '2510 Fan' (A4Tv035; each head's 2510 fan is it or a link to it)

materials.name: NdFeB N52 magnet
materials.source: Arnold Magnetic Technologies, Sintered Neodymium-Iron-Boron Magnets N52 datasheet (rev. 210802), read 2026-11-17: density 7.6 g/cm3. MadMax's BOM calls for 6x3 mm N52 (zruncho3d/madmax BOM.md at 277a63c); the A4Tv2 and door magnets use the same card.
materials.description: Sintered NdFeB (neodymium) magnets, grade N52: a real material (the density is the datasheet's).
